title: Measures to Reduce Unclaimed CPF Monies
what_it_is: Measures to Reduce Unclaimed CPF Monies

sections.label: Unused CPF monies distribution
sections.summary: About 98% of unused CPF monies of deceased members were distributed by CPF Board or the Public Trustee's Office over five years.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In fact, about 98% of all unused CPF monies belonging to deceased members were distributed by CPF Board or the Public Trustee’s Office (PTO) over the last five years.

sections.label: Nomination rates below age 45
sections.summary: Members below age 45 who pass away are much less likely to have made a nomination.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The clearest difference is that members below the age of 45 who pass away are much less likely to have made a nomination.

sections.label: Electronic nomination system and applications
sections.summary: CPF Board is exploring a new electronic nomination system in the first quarter of next year, and processed about 120,000 nominations in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: CPF Board is also exploring providing a new electronic nomination system in the first quarter of next year.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In 2018, CPF Board processed about 120,000 nomination applications, more than double the 50,000 nominations made in 2013.

sections.label: Public Trustee tracing next-of-kin
sections.summary: The Public Trustee's Office searches for next-of-kin and traces their whereabouts to return unused CPF monies when no nomination was made.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If we break down what the problem really is, as long as the person has a next-of-kin, even if the person did not make a nomination, the Public Trustee's Office will try and search for the next-of-kin and trace the person's whereabouts and make an effort to return the unused CPF monies.

sections.label: Electronic nomination launch and payout question
sections.summary: The electronic nomination means will be launched in the first quarter of next year, and a question on Retirement Sum Scheme payouts is deferred.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Perhaps, they will find that maybe if they make a nomination today, and tomorrow, if they change their mind, it is not so difficult to do as well.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: This electronic means of doing so, we will be launching in the first quarter of next year.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: To Mr Chong Kee Hiong's second question on the Retirement Sum Scheme payouts, Mr Speaker, may I have your permission to take it within my Second Reading speech later in the Sitting that deals with the CPF (Amendment) Act?

sections.label: Overseas missions contacting CPF Board
sections.summary: Relevant parties may be informed overseas, and missions overseas can then get in touch with the CPF Board.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Sometimes, they may not inform relevant parties in Singapore, they may inform our missions overseas.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And our missions overseas can then get in touch with the CPF Board.
